name: everkeep
description: Your notes in one folder on your computer: Claude reads them at the start of a chat and writes down what you worked out.
long_description: Everkeep keeps notes, decisions and projects as plain files in one folder. Claude reads and edits them through 20 tools under write policies you set: a folder can be read-only, edits can require the current version of a file, and discarded files go to a trash instead of being deleted. On the first start in a folder without a CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md, Everkeep adds a starter CLAUDE.md, so the first chat sets the folder up by asking what you want to keep. Text, Markdown and common documents (PDF, Word, spreadsheets) are read as numbered lines. SQLite and PDF page images need sqlite3 and poppler installed separately.

env.EVERKEEP_SETTINGS_UI: the extension settings in Claude Desktop

vault.title: Notes folder
vault.description: The folder for your notes (default: everkeep in your home folder, created on first start). On the first start in a folder that has no CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md, Everkeep adds a starter CLAUDE.md, and a .vault-policy marker if there is none; it never adds them to that folder again. Other files in the folder are not touched.

readonly_folders.title: Read-only folders
readonly_folders.description: Folders inside the notes folder that Claude may read but not change (sources, archives). On start Everkeep writes a read-only .vault-policy marker into each one that has no marker, and removes it again when the folder leaves this list. A folder with a marker of its own keeps it.
